verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs describe Deep Research, which conducts in-depth research across Search, Gmail and Drive sources. The Gemini API docs also state you can "hand multi-step work to a managed agent," which together cover the delegation of multi-step work. Neither source documents the task running autonomously in the background, notifying the user, or returning a result for review, so only the core of the story is evidenced. Scheduled actions are a recurring schedule rather than a one-off delegated task, so they are not credited. missing for 10: explicit background or asynchronous execution in the consumer app, a completion notification and review workflow, documented multi-step planning detail, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps.
